highlights.title: Agents move off an account that is running out
highlights.line: With two or more Claude subscriptions, Kosmos moves idle agents off one near its weekly limit to one with room. Settings can turn it off.

highlights.title: Older Safari opens your board
highlights.line: An older Safari (before 16.4) now shows your board through Kosmos+, its pictures and previews included, not a signed-out page.

highlights.title: An agent's name can hold an apostrophe
highlights.line: A name like O'Brien's helper now works when you make an agent: the name you see keeps the apostrophe.

highlights.title: Fewer sign-in asks from a phone
highlights.line: From a phone or another computer, a sign-in with your authenticator code counts for as long as it lasts, so making an agent stops asking.

highlights.title: Update Kosmos from the board on Linux
highlights.line: On a Kosmos Cloud machine, or a Linux computer running Kosmos as its usual service, Update on the board now installs a newer Kosmos.
